verdict.rationale: Buzz ships an official scriptable CLI (buzz-cli) with non-interactive commands, including `buzz workflows trigger`/`approve --token`, channel creation and repo protection. Its agent stack is explicitly designed for headless operation: buzz-agent is "stdio in, tool calls out" and "purpose-built for headless autonomous coding work", and remote agents run on Kubernetes with no desktop control channel. Automation is further supported by YAML-as-code workflows, keyless git push via Nostr credentials, and a live Helm chart for deployment. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline integration docs or examples (e.g. using the CLI inside a CI runner), documented non-interactive credential/env configuration for the CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
